name: Boon Of The Furious Storm
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Eye of the Storm
features.description: You have Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage. While you are Bloodied, you have Immunity to Lightning and Thunder damage.

features.name: Storm’s Strength
features.description: Creatures have Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells that deal Lightning or Thunder damage.
